Built around Valkey. Inspired by nature.
A LITTLE SCIENCE. A LITTLE WONDER.

The shape of a keyspace.

Each primary node grows its own fractal tree. Its hash slots split into smaller and smaller branches. Every dot is a real key, placed along the branch belonging to its slot.

key → CRC16 → hash slot → node → branch

Keys sharing a {hash-tag} share a slot and grow together. Select a node to isolate its tree, or search for a key to follow its path.

The collector reads CLUSTER SLOTS, DBSIZE and SCAN. It never reads values or changes your data. The sample limit bounds scanning and rendering; counts show the full database size. Scans are not atomic and may differ while keys move or expire.
